description: Dispositions for every cycle and unresolved pointer in docs/graph-report.md (scripts/graph/anomalies.ts; issue #11). Each anomaly needs exactly one entry, with a non-empty reason; an entry whose anomaly is gone fails the test. Cycles are keyed by relation and node list as the report prints them. Dispositions: reference_cycle (a mutual reference link, with no execution order), mutual_dependency (a rule and the procedure that applies it, a handoff plus an input, or one passage split into records that name each other; never recursion), bounded_reentry (a self-loop whose repetition the book defines and bounds). A cycle that could make execution or precedence ill-defined is not dispositioned away: it gets a review/ issue named in issues. Unresolved pointers are keyed by owner and exact wording. Dispositions: modelling_note (a structural or modelling note, not a book pointer), external_book (points into a not_present book), external_component (points to a game component outside the book), book_undefined (the book leaves it open), now_resolvable (a target id exists and is named in target; bind it, then remove the entry). issues lists review issues that record the open point.
